summary: Ran public API smoke tests and browser auth flow. Login UI loads, but all public API requests returned Cloudflare 502 and sign-in could not reach the backend.

critical.issue: Public origin returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway for every request; backend service logs indicate ModuleNotFoundError: reportlab during startup/import.

integration_issues.issue: Submitting valid admin credentials displays the Cloudflare origin error and remains on /login because POST /api/auth/login returns 502.

action_items: Restore/install the missing reportlab backend dependency or remove the eager import that prevents the API origin from serving requests.
After backend startup is fixed, rerun health, cookie auth, /api/auth/me, and all protected dashboard routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend dependency imports must be validated against requirements.txt; reportlab is imported by restored code but unavailable at runtime, resulting in total API outage.
seed_data_creation: None. Credentials file was empty; tested requested admin@example.com/admin123 based on server.py defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page renders with all requested controls and no uncaught page errors. API/public origin is unavailable with 502; protected dashboard routes and unauthenticated redirect remain untested.
rca of the issue: Requests to the configured public URL consistently returned Cloudflare 502. Supervisor backend stderr exposed ModuleNotFoundError: reportlab, indicating an unavailable restored dependency/import during backend startup or route loading.
